#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
TASK_TRANSFER="${GENOS_DEV_ROOT:-${HOME}/DEV}/TRANSFER"
TASK_LOG_DIR="$TASK_TRANSFER/workflow-live-cards-r2-logs"
if ! mkdir -p "$TASK_LOG_DIR"; then
    TASK_LOG_DIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/8-agent-workflow-live-cards-r2-$(id -u)"
    mkdir -p "$TASK_LOG_DIR"
fi
TASK_LOG="$TASK_LOG_DIR/prepare-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$TASK_LOG") 2>&1
trap 'TASK_STATUS=$?; echo "EXIT=$TASK_STATUS LOG=$TASK_LOG"; exit "$TASK_STATUS"' EXIT
echo "Preparing verified editor files only; preserve the existing SSE backend and data"
python3 - "$TASK_TRANSFER/workflow-live-cards-r2-editor" <<'EDITOR_PREPARE_PY'
import base64,hashlib,io,json,os,sys,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
raw=base64.b64decode('')
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='cc487a2df9c1365a20a11261873d8ba3ced19247600077e45417970b07706c7e'
expected={'GENOS_WORKFLOW_LIVE_CARDS_20261008_R2_PASTE_ALL.txt': '2f2bc35f1b7d1dbf5b8868fc751b5faae2185f84ee8fee94dee4a60ced6b2c5c', 'genos_rag_chat.py': '8169782d80b532ac9cf3985ba6a0f2fa2fcd02da575c652c968136c2668da00e', 'GUIDE_UTF8.txt': 'cd73a78b1b9c4944b5491a2d093252c41a477dc34bec5522ec454ca7169aeb28', 'VALIDATION_SUMMARY.txt': '3ad1157125e6988f12b9fa22a825c1381c2561c61ac7ebbca6822f430b249ff7', 'VALIDATION.json': 'e6c5ac3cece6286037d9a45966d7dabb430ae02f588b78e3f4d0d5cb154d344c', 'VERIFY_EDITOR_FILES.txt': 'dffa14323a134a4b22cf173223973ee647075c102c6dd5d1eedccdbe1eb8afe8', 'MANIFEST.json': 'eed9670c490382fcf18dbee4d09972482a26169704a7710d865d33101dbe6d5c', 'PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS.txt': 'e3033d8e1ace60ca7ac6461688a9cbee92a671c39d4670c150e838e3927733fc'}
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
if root.is_symlink():raise SystemExit('Existing editor output symlink preserved; choose a separate output')
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as z:
 assert set(z.namelist())==set(expected)
 assert z.testzip() is None
 payload={name:z.read(name) for name in expected}
 for name,blob in payload.items():
  assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()==expected[name]
  target=root/name
  if target.is_symlink():raise SystemExit('Existing symlink preserved: '+str(target))
  if target.exists() and target.read_bytes()!=blob:raise SystemExit('Existing different editor file preserved: '+str(target))
 root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 for name,blob in payload.items():
  target=root/name
  if not target.exists():
   temp=root/(name+'.writing')
   with temp.open('xb') as f:f.write(blob)
   temp.replace(target)
 for name,pin in expected.items():assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==pin
print(json.dumps({'status':'EDITOR_FILES_READY','output':str(root.resolve()),
 'paste_file':str((root/'GENOS_WORKFLOW_LIVE_CARDS_20261008_R2_PASTE_ALL.txt').resolve()),
 'zip_sha256':'cc487a2df9c1365a20a11261873d8ba3ced19247600077e45417970b07706c7e',
 'workflow_saved':False,'backend_modified':False,'generation_modified':False},ensure_ascii=False))
EDITOR_PREPARE_PY
bash "$TASK_TRANSFER/workflow-live-cards-r2-editor/VERIFY_EDITOR_FILES.txt"
